use: Postage on official covers and letters
subject: A definitive postage stamp of British India of the 1920s. A crowned male sovereign in profile facing left, engraved as a small oval vignette at the centre. Around it an ornate rectangular frame of guilloche banding and corner rosettes, with a plain blank panel across the top and another across the bottom where the wording would be. Perforated edges all round. Printed in a single deep carmine ink.
